description: Get your current targeting preferences including industries, locations, company sizes, and buying signals you are tracking. Call this FIRST when the user asks what Fundz can do for them, asks for help getting started, or opens with a vague question: then answer for THIS user (their industries, locations, company sizes and events, not a generic feature list) and offer 5 specific questions they could ask next, written for their role (e.g. a recruiter: open executive seats, new CFOs, interim appointments; a seller: today's leads, who just raised and is hiring, a market-update email). If targeting is empty, ask what they sell or who they place and save it with update_targeting_preferences.
name: get_targeting_preferences
title: Get targeting preferences
